comments: One bank on the ball's lowest point: one scale for all seven frames; the ball touches the floor at the anchor.
The toll frames are imported and approved; the rules' toll is a sound 36 ticks before a ball rolls out, with no boulder yet to paint, so the stage plays the roll frames only.
geometry: Rules hitbox 28x28 centred on the anchor, on the snow ledge floor; the painted ball may spill past it. toll is the 36-tick warning before one rolls out; art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: the ball turned a quarter clockwise each cell (roll-0..3: slit at the bottom, left, top, right), then toll-0..2 (tilt left, tilt right, slit gaping wide).
